lesson.title: Picnic baskets
lesson.subtitle: Find a total from equal groups
lesson.story: There are 4 baskets with 3 counters in each. How many counters are there altogether?
lesson.objective: Find the total in equal groups.

steps.title: Identify the unknown
steps.prompt: What does the question ask you to find?

choices.label: How many counters are in each group
How many counters there are in all
How many equal groups there are

hints: Read the question at the end of the story.
Separate the number of groups from the number in each group.
Decide whether the question asks for altogether, in each group, or how many groups.
Choose: The total number of counters

steps.title: Use equal groups
steps.prompt: How many counters are there altogether?
hints: Count the same number of counters in every group.
Each group must contain the same number.
4 equal groups with 3 in each make 12 altogether.

steps.title: Explain equal groups

choices.label: Every group contains the same number of counters.
Each group can have a different number of counters.
The number of groups is always the total number of counters.

hints: Count the counters in two groups.
Equal groups have the same number in each group.
Choose: Every group contains the same number of counters.

sourceSpans.text: There are 4 baskets with 3 counters in each. How many counters are there altogether?

assumptions: Every group has the same number of objects.
